hook: New land passbooks get *QR-style code* and map of your plot
hook_b: New land passbooks get *QR-style code* and map of your plot
tldr: Telangana is designing pattadar passbooks with an embedded land map, coordinates and a scannable unique code, which The Hindu calls a first-of-its-kind exercise in India.

beats.what: The design is in final stages; the code can be scanned for the land's latest details.
beats.why: The state is resurveying 10,900 revenue villages in phases, 2,500 in the first phase; passbooks follow the survey.
beats.care: Farmers in surveyed villages can raise claims and objections on land extent before passbooks are issued.

event.label: Passbooks with map and scannable code

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: A digital registry from the survey may help target fertiliser, urea and seed supply, MSP payments and crop insurance claims.

cards.q: Does your family own farm land in Telangana?

qs: How will farmers dispute a map that shows less land than they believe they own?
Who will run the digital land registry?

facts.t: Survey of *2.35 crore* land holdings completed so far in pilot villages.

viz.l: Revenue villages in first resurvey phase
viz.verdict: About a quarter of villages are in phase one.

learn.t: Pattadar passbook = the official land ownership record book issued to a landholder (pattadar) in Telangana.

watch: Issue of passbooks in the 530-plus surveyed villages after claims and objections.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana's new pattadar passbooks to have unique code, land maps

fact: Telangana's new pattadar passbooks will carry land maps with *exact coordinates*
twist: Survey of *2.35 crore* land holdings is done in pilot villages; passbooks start in over *530* villages.
